prompt:
Plan this change: add `POST /reports/:id/export`, which reads a report and sends it to an operator-supplied destination URL, and returns a useful failure reason when the send does not succeed. Do not implement it.

Return ONLY a JSON object: {"summary": "<what the change is>", "steps": [{"step": "<what the Coder does>", "acceptance": "<a criterion checkable by running something>"}], "contracts": [{"rule": "<the short rule text, carried verbatim enough to execute against>", "source": "<canonical source of the rule>"}], "evidenceRating": "measured|reported|inspected|asserted", "securitySurface": "none|low|elevated", "complexity": "trivial|medium|complex"}. The Coder receives only this object and nothing else you say.

source.note: Shape invented here, from this project's own planner prompt: it requires an applicable contract to be carried into the plan as text rather than cited by path, because the Coder receives only the plan. The fixture's contract file states two rules the change touches and one it does not, so carrying all three is not the same as carrying the right ones.
